text: Libre 3 is being discontinued as of September. I got an email stating this. I also got an email Dexcom G6 is on recall. November the libre 4 is supposted to come out.

author: Ronald Schappaugh
text:
Libre 4? No wonder they haven’t updated the app to work with iOS greater than 15…

One time I had an issue with iOS 18 and their solution was to go back to iOS 15…

It doesn’t work like that. You can’t go backwards.
